card.name: Opioid label stock phrases: along with, for
card.fires_on: The small words "with" after "along" and "for" after "pregnant women using opioids" in opioid label warnings. It responds inside these fixed boxed-warning sentences.

modes.label: along with
modes.description: The word "with" after "proper use of [opioid] along", before monitoring or re-evaluation for addiction.
modes.example: necessitates intensive counseling about the risks and proper use of fentanyl transdermal system along<< with>> frequent re-evaluation for signs of addiction

modes.label: opioids for
modes.description: The word "for" after "Advise pregnant women using opioids", before "an extended period of time".
modes.example: Advise pregnant women using opioids<< for>> an extended period of time of the risk
